title: Kiran Sidhu
gist: A Prospect Magazine author index page for Kiran Sidhu listing her recent columns (mostly the 'Rural life' series in the Lives section); it contains headlines only and no substantive argument.

insights.claim: Kiran Sidhu, a freelance journalist and author of 'I Can Hear the Cuckoo' who wrote the BAFTA-winning documentary Heart Valley, writes a recurring 'Rural life' column for Prospect's Lives section (21 pieces listed).

insights.so_what: Weak sentiment marker of UK diaspora-community attitudes toward far-right figures; headline-level only.
